style: Cute children's storybook illustration for ages 5-6. Soft rounded shapes, thick soft outlines, gentle pastel colors, big friendly eyes, happy expression, clean flat shading with a little watercolor texture. Nothing scary.
spriteRules: Single character or object only, centered, whole thing visible with a little margin, side view. Background must be one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) with no gradient, no shadow, no ground, no text, no border.
